adds.after:
- When a P0 handoff directive is injected into a task, load the session-handoff skill before continuing execution.
- Record a compact completion handoff using the skill's 9-section document structure when the task finishes.
- If section 4 for unfinished items is empty, terminate the handoff chain with no next hop scheduled.
- Persist handoff documents under D:/plan/skills/ as HANDOFF-CHAIN-<Task>-hop<N>-<timestamp>.md.

updates.before:
- Read `select.json` with a text read tool, not an image-reading tool; when terminal output is truncated and the picked count exceeds the displayed rows, read the full file and fill in omitted middle entries.
- If URIs appear garbled due to console encoding, obtain them with proper UTF-8 output.
- When a single-line output is truncated, use Python to extract a compact candidate list and also locate the code repository root.
- When output is truncated and Chinese directory names are garbled, export the complete information to a UTF-8 file and read it back.
- When candidate content has very long lines or full-text entries are elided, dump the complete candidate contents into a readable UTF-8 file in the cache directory and read it in line-range batches.
- When the read tool is blocked by the exploration gate for a specific known cache file, use a bounded file inspector instead.
- Read all candidate memories in parallel as the verification baseline; when only some outputs are truncated, supplement only those entries, avoid rereading complete ones, and inspect the repository layout before source verification.
- When several middle candidate full-text entries are omitted, first grep all URIs and SHAs into an index, then read only the missing content by line range without repeating complete entries.
- When verification cost rises, narrow reading to the still-unread ranges and switch to a compact batched verifier instead of continuing broad reads.
- 筛选脚本把候选全文打到 stdout 属于预期行为，不要重复大段输出，也不要误判为检索失误；直接用文本 read 工具读取权威文件（如 select.json）取得内容。
